events.title: JAJAJA: The Joy of Creating from Within
events.description:
In celebration of Hispanic Heritage Month, Poster House presents a panel discussion exploring how one’s cultural background, lived experience, and memory can inform their creative practice.

Hosted by artist and designer Zipeng Zhu, this conversation will bring together Abraham Lule, Daniela Castiblanco, Isabel Urbina Peña, and Carlos Bocai to reflect on what it means to make deeply personal work. Together, the panelists will consider how heritage and identity can shape visual language, as well as how humor, joy, and play manifest in the creative process.

events.title: Poster Tots: Paper Puppets
events.description: Très mignon! Trailblazing female design duo Lefor-Openo created an iconic cartoon style in their posters, as highlighted in our exhibition Cuteness, Conservatism, & Consumption: Lefor-Openo and Postwar France. Lefor Openo’s signature characters are the template for this month’s Poster Tots workshop, which introduces little ones to the timeless joy of creating and decorating paper figures. Practice cutting and pasting and design a character that would fit right in on Lefor-Openo’s posters!

events.title: Third Sunday Always Free
events.description:
Poster House is free on the third Sunday of every month, often featuring complimentary programming geared toward families. Be sure to sign up to secure your spot—or just enjoy the museum at your own pace!

Accessibility Note: Masks are available free of charge at the museum. Assistive listening devices and stools are available. ASL (American Sign Language) interpretation or a CART (Communication Access Realtime Translation) is also available upon request.
